<thought>We need a template that, in the forward direction, converts an aliphatic hydroxyl into an alkyl halide (break C‑O, form C‑X). In retrosynthesis this means the template should break an alkyl halide bond and form an aliphatic hydroxyl. The halogenated product from the precursor list is `CC(CN1CCCCC1CC1CCCCC1)c1cccc(Br)c1`. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break an alkyl halide and form an aliphatic hydroxyl on this molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"CC(CN1CCCCC1CC1CCCCC1)c1cccc(Br)c1","functional_groups_broken":["alkyl halide"],"functional_groups_formed":["aliphatic hydroxyls"],"limit":10}</action_input>
